controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: energy isolation failure on P-7110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-7110, M-7110 and PT-7110 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-7110 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 10 July 2021 an incident occurred on P-7110, M-7110 and PT-7110 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
